title: Interrupted Sequences
scenario: Find numbers where a streak of 3 was 'interrupted' by a single different number, then resumed. Return 'num'.
correctQuery: SELECT DISTINCT l1.num FROM logs l1 JOIN logs l3 ON l1.id = l3.id - 2 JOIN logs l5 ON l1.id = l5.id - 4 WHERE l1.num = l3.num AND l3.num = l5.num;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '2'), (3, '1'), (4, '2'), (5, '1');
